description: This file defines a reusable Button component with configurable variants and sizes, leveraging React, class-variance-authority, and radix UI Slot for flexible rendering.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: React functional component for a flexible, styled button, with support for rendering as a different element via the 'asChild' prop.
